title: SB1180 (2017 Regular): Public Safety - Handgun Permit Review Board - Repeal

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2017RS/bills/sb/sb1180f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader: the bill as filed. No passage vote recorded. Also repeals § 5-302 (the Board) and deletes the Board's review powers in § 5-312(b)-(d); 'Board' definition in § 5-301(b) deleted.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-312(a)): (a) (1) A person who is denied a permit or renewal of a permit or whose permit is revoked or limited may request TO APPEAL the decision of the Secretary TO THE OFFICE OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS by filing a written request with the SECRETARY within 10 days after receipt of written notice of the Secretary’s final action.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-312(a)): (2) A person whose application for a permit or renewal of a permit is not acted on by the Secretary within 90 days after submitting the application to the Secretary may request a hearing before the OFFICE OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS by filing a written request with the SECRETARY.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-312(B)): (2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1) of this subsection, a court may not order the issuance or renewal of a permit or alter a limitation on a permit pending a final determination of the proceeding.
